fields.teaching: names the matched row and the degree it encodes — plain, intensive, or absolute — against the plain agent noun of the same root
when the row ends in a taa, states that it intensifies and that gender must be read from agreement instead
for shared rows, shows the quality-adjective reading beside the intensive one and names the transitivity test; for homograph skeletons, shows both templates and no winner
marks a following annexed noun as the source verb's underlying object, as a reading to check rather than a case fact
